articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: Taiko reopens bridge after $1.7M exploit, says users made whole
articles.snippet: Taiko restored bridge transfers after replenishing asset backing and completing security fixes following an 11-day network disruption.

articles.title: OpenAI weighs 5% stake for US government amid Trump talks: FT
articles.snippet: OpenAI has reportedly discussed giving the US government a 5% equity stake in early Trump administration talks as Washington tightens AI model oversight.

articles.title: Dubai crypto market hits 50 licensed firms after new VARA approval
articles.snippet: Dubai’s VARA has licensed its 50th crypto firm, though only 39 VASPs were fully operational at the end of 2025 as the emirate’s regulated market continues to expand.

articles.title: Taiwan Passes Sweeping Crypto Law With Licensing, Stablecoin Rules
articles.snippet: The new law puts virtual asset firms under FSC oversight for the first time and sets reserve-and-trust rules for stablecoins.
